name: TrustDemo
title: SMART Trust demonstrator: journeys J1 to J4
description: The user journeys of one cross-border family, told as journeys (birth-dose DVCs in Taifafeki, CHW registration and triage read in Onesa, clinic verification, vaccine-code mapping and schedule, family VHLs on one phone, viewed and audited back in Taifafeki) as a WHO SMART Guidelines L2 DAK and L3 implementation guide, built on the SMART Trust HCERT libraries.
